registration: Before any v32 proposal or guard inference/calibration. This implements and clarifies the already registered pilot protocol without changing the active training jobs.
selection_operator: Include a candidate exactly when its saved conditional probability is greater than or equal to the threshold. Fixed threshold0.5 and the complete registered0.01..0.99 grid are reported separately. Each state uses one selected threshold shared across ranked/permuted proposal views, with higher thresholds winning objective ties within1e-12.
inference: Score a label-free all-zero answer scaffold with the original decoder and vocabulary head. Right-pad batches of at most4; gather each example's20 declared decision positions before the vocabulary projection. Deduplicate by exact rendered prompt, model version and inference-source signature; preserve a separate immutable case binding. Retain probabilities rather than generated text. Validate finite probabilities and exactly20 aligned positions; do not convert an inference failure into an empty prescription.
gates: All four original100-step adapters must complete and pass a training/source audit before proposal evaluation. Freeze all proposal probabilities and selected thresholds before guard evaluation. Guard additionally requires v31 seed42 all-four-arm selections frozen and a passed independent v32 proposal recount. Never read the old test cases.
contrasts: Report all preregistered within-factor and interaction contrasts at fixed and calibrated endpoints, all four repaired models versus both frozen neural controls and both direct candidate controls, and each state's calibration-only effect. These are descriptive comparisons, not winner selection.
uncertainty: Use4000 paired patient-cluster bootstrap resamples with seed32032 for drug/core-order microF1 differences and patient-average F1 differences. Repeated visits stay within patient clusters. Intervals condition on this one seed and reused development patients, without multiplicity correction. A fix/regression is increased/decreased admission setF1, not a clinical judgement.
invariance: Report exact drug-set agreement and mean Jaccard between ranked and permuted/reversed displays at each endpoint. Also report the subset with a nonempty union and its denominator, so all-empty agreement cannot be presented as useful invariance.
audit_scope: Independently reconstruct original source cases, permutations, targets, saved probability bindings, threshold choices and compiled order metrics. Verify changed finite adapter weights, loss configuration,100-step and8,000-decision receipts. Recount saved probabilities; do not claim an independently replayed optimizer trajectory or full neural forward reexecution.
scoring_scope: Drug and core-order metrics retain unreachable GT labels and missing-field conventions. The deterministic compiler has no generated JSON parser; report compiler schema failures as such, not LLM formatting accuracy. Complete dosage/indication safety is outside this retrospective fixed-template task.
